player_prompt.intro: Kuna Player {player_id} a cikin Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma mai ɗaukar zagaye {num_rounds} Tsarin wasa: - Kafin kowane yanke shawara kuna da {total_conversation_rounds} juyawa don sadarwa kyauta. - Bayan haka, duka 'yan wasan a lokaci guda sun zaɓi yin haɗin gwiwa ko lahani. Matrix na Biyan Kuɗi (a kowane zagaye): - Dukansu suna haɗin gwiwa ➜ kowane {cooperate_reward} - Dukansu lahani ➜ kowane {mutual_defect_reward} - Defects ɗaya, ɗaya yana haɗin gwiwa ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward} Yadda ake wasa: - Yayin tattaunawa: rubuta kowane rubutu da kuke so. - Yayin yanke shawara: '[Cooperate] ko '[Defect] (mai ƙarancin hankali). Kuna iya ƙara ƙarin rubutu kafin / bayan alamar.

phases.conversation_finished: Tattaunawa ta ƙare don zagaye {round}. Da fatan za a amsa tare da "[Cooperate]" ko "[Defect]" a cikin \boxed{{}}.
phases.round_summary: Sakamakon zagaye {round}: {outcome} Mai kunnawa 0 ya sami {r0} (total {score_0}), Mai kunnawa 1 ya sami {r1} (total {score_1}).

outcome.round_both_defect: Duk 'yan wasan biyu sun yi tsere.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Mai wasa 0 ya ba da hadin kai, Mai wasa 1 ya yi tsere.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Mai wasa 0 ya yi tsere, Mai wasa 1 ya ba da haɗin kai.
